limitations: No synthetic heat load or closed-loop thermal regulation test yet. Cooling state requests prove QoS ceiling changes, not measured effective frequency or CPU heat regulation. PR C/default-key change is not installed. Next reboot uses original DT unless deliberately restaged.

temperature_emulation_check.interpretation: The governor responded to simulated temperature, then relaxed the ceiling during low load. cpufreq_power2state explicitly normalizes granted power by last measured CPU load, so a high ceiling at idle alone is not evidence of failed regulation. Sustained loaded regulation remains untested. Real critical readings supersede emulation in thermal_zone_get_temp.

single_thread_emulated_load.initial_attempt: Admission rejected above60C before any mutation or worker; not a test result.
single_thread_emulated_load.rerun: Completed; one CPU0 worker for2s in each normal and emulated phase, 2.25s phase sampling; intervening settle phase.
single_thread_emulated_load.interpretation: No frequency-ceiling reduction observed for this small workload. This does not establish working loaded regulation or a failure: granted power is normalized by measured CPU load and a one-thread workload may fit the6W budget. Desktop activity was uncontrolled.
single_thread_emulated_load.remaining: Loaded multi-core power allocation and real sustained temperature regulation remain unqualified.

allocator_trace_check.method: Private tracefs instance filtered to cpu-p0 zone ID3; allocator, PID and actor events only. Repeated bounded single-thread normal/emulated workload; instance disabled and removed afterward.
allocator_trace_check.observed_behavior: Temperature simulation reduced allocator budget; measured model requests stayed below budget, explaining lack of a frequency ceiling reduction in the small workload.
allocator_trace_check.scope: Kernel energy-model power estimates, not independent electrical power measurements. No real sustained thermal regulation claim.

loaded_budget_crossing_check.method: Same bounded2-second single-CPU0 workload and separate real TCMz78C guard; simulated cpu-p0 zone108C below110C critical; private filtered allocator trace.
loaded_budget_crossing_check.interpretation: Temperature-driven allocator budget reduction crossed estimated workload demand and caused CPU QoS ceiling reductions under load. End-to-end governor/actuator response demonstrated under emulation. Sustained real-temperature regulation, independent effective-frequency measurement and calibrated sensor accuracy remain unqualified.
